turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on past questions with did?
turns.tutor:
You may know that "did" is for the past. Before we make questions, let us check the past form of a verb. Look: Every day I open the shop. Two days ago I opened the shop. The action is finished, so "open" gets -ed: "opened".
The rule: many verbs take -ed when the action is finished and in the past.
Right: On Friday my brother painted the door. Wrong: On Friday my brother paint the door.
Now you. Write the past form: Last month they ___ (move) to a new flat.
